topics.definition: Vision Transformers apply transformer architectures to image recognition tasks by processing image patches.
tips: Usually benefit from large training datasets.

topics.definition: Images are divided into small patches that are treated like tokens.
tips: Patch size affects accuracy and speed.

topics.definition: Self-attention learns relationships between image patches.
Hybrid models combine CNN feature extraction with transformer reasoning.
Swin Transformer computes attention within shifted windows for efficient vision processing.
Benchmarks evaluate computer vision models on standard datasets.
tips: Compare models using the same benchmark.

topics.definition: Vision transformers are used in classification, detection, segmentation and medical imaging.
tips: Select the architecture based on the task.

topics.definition: Use suitable patch sizes, augment data and evaluate on diverse datasets.
